final: WITH type_avgs AS (SELECT e.type, AVG(1.0 * b.spent / b.amount) AS avg_ratio FROM budget b JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id WHERE b.spent IS NOT NULL AND b.spent <> 0 AND b.amount IS NOT NULL AND b.amount <> 0 GROUP BY e.type), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS mean_type_avg FROM type_avgs) SELECT type, avg_ratio, avg_ratio - mean_type_avg AS distance_from_mean FROM type_avgs CROSS JOIN overall
